fact: The Inspector-General of Police, speaking at the 2025 Accra Metropolitan University convocation lecture, named the District Police Information Management System (DPIMS) among the Ghana Police Service's current technological initiatives, and announced a Real-Time Crime Centre, an AI crime prediction platform and a crime-reporting mobile app as planned; the article does not say what DPIMS records or how many districts or stations use it.
title: IGP Yohuno outlines digital future for Ghana Police with AI and real-time crime tools
